speakerA.en: Who is your best friend, Nora?
Why do you trust her so much?
That sounds like real friendship. I want a friend like that.
Thanks, that makes me happy. Let's spend more time together.

speakerB.en: That's easy. It's Maya. We have been friends since primary school.
Because she always keeps my secrets, and she tells me the truth, even when it's hard.
You already have one. I think we get along really well.
Great idea! We can study together after school.

scenarios.context: A student talks to a friend before a speech.

speakerA.en: You look pale, Sam. Are you okay?
Why are you so worried? You prepared very well.
Try to take a deep breath and speak slowly. It really helps.
I'm sure it will. And I'll be in the front row, smiling at you.

speakerB.en: Not really. I'm nervous about my presentation today.
I know, but I always forget everything when people look at me.
Do you think it will work?
Thank you. That makes me feel much better.

scenarios.context: A girl is sad about a test.

speakerA.en: Hi Lina. You look really disappointed. What happened?
I'm sorry to hear that. That must feel terrible.
It wasn't for nothing. Maybe you can find out which topics were difficult.
Exactly. And next time, I'll practice with you.

speakerB.en: I studied for two weeks, but I only got fifty percent on the math test.
It does. I feel like all my hard work was for nothing.
That's a good idea. I can ask the teacher for help.
Thanks, Ali. You always know what to say.

speakerA.en: Guess what, Mina? I'm so excited!
My football team won the school cup yesterday, and I scored the last goal!
I am. I couldn't sleep last night because I was so happy.
Thank you. We're having a small party on Friday. Would you like to come?

speakerB.en: Tell me! What happened?
Wow, congratulations! You must be so proud.
You worked hard for this. You really deserve it.
Of course! I'd love to. I'm looking forward to it.

speakerA.en: Reza, can we talk for a minute? I feel bad about yesterday.
I'm sorry I shouted at you. It was not fair.
Next time, let's stay calm and listen to each other.
I agree. Let's forget about it and start again.

speakerB.en: Me too. I was angry and I said some unkind things.
I'm sorry too. You are an important friend to me.
That's a good rule. Trust is more important than winning an argument.
Deal. Shall we go and get some ice cream?
